items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: I turned him down three times because I was doing other stuff. But a guy who used to follow me around all the time... Got on Buddy’s band playing all my licks.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was like deeply in debt to the government.

Horrible, horrible. But he would do things, he would drop us in a bus at some ratty hotel and then he’d go on to live at a much higher up the food chain type hotel. Either that or Buddy Rich. Buddy would not pay his guys for three or four weeks. So they were all indebted to him because they wanted the money that they’d already earned. And yet some of the greatest players in the world have come out of the “Buddy Rich School of Boot Camp.” And they all loved him. They all loved him. And they all admired and…
Um hum. Did that include Don Menza?
